neighbours.label: the subword that continues a rare surname right after its opening 'D' / 'Dum' piece (D|amb|rot, Dum|f|ries, D|amin|eli); the same pieces after another initial stay quiet
fire: The prize was shared by Laura Dambrauskas and two colleagues from Vilnius.
Our next speaker is Professor Peter Dumfort of the history department.
Minutes were taken by Mrs. Dambach, the club secretary.
The portrait was painted by Nino Dumbadze in the early thirties.
Col. Dambreville thanked the volunteers for their service.
Sound design was handled by Marta Damineli and her team.
The goal was scored by Ivan Dumbrava in the final minute.
Flowers were sent by Mr. and Mrs. Dambrosky of Elm Street.

notes: Probes: Dambrosio 1.01, Dumfries 0.91, Dambazau 0.88, Dumbrell 0.79; Lambrosio 0.12, 'dumbbell' 0.12, ' damage' 0.01. The + pole peaks on ' Gam' opening a surname (Gammon, Gamble), so the unit may separate surname openings by letter. Tokenization of the new names was not checked.
